name: United Quest Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Purchases made with your Quest Card outside the U.S. will not be subject to foreign transaction fees.

categories.label: Hotel stays prepaid through Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers
All other travel (airfare, trains, local transit, cruise lines, hotels, car rentals, taxicabs, resorts, ride share, tolls)

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles earned automatically transferred to United MileagePlus after end of each billing cycle. Miles can be used for flights on United and other airline partners, hotel stays, car rentals, merchandise, eGift cards and more. No blackout dates on United-operated flights. MileagePlus miles never expire.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 bonus miles + 500 PQP after you spend $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months. Total up to 70,000 bonus miles + 500 PQP.

benefits.title: $200 United Travel Credit
benefits.description: Receive $200 in United TravelBank cash after account opening and on each account anniversary, which you can use to book a future United or United Express operated flight.

benefits.title: 10,000-Mile Anniversary Award Flight Discount
benefits.description: Starting with your first anniversary and every anniversary thereafter, you'll get a 10,000-mile discount to use toward an eligible award flight.

benefits.title: 10,000-Mile Award Flight Discount After $20K Spend
benefits.description: Earn a 10,000-mile award flight discount after spending $20,000 each calendar year to use toward an eligible award flight.

benefits.title: Free First and Second Checked Bags
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and one companion can each check a first and second standard bags for free - save up to $440 per roundtrip.

benefits.title: 2 Global Economy Plus Seat Upgrades
benefits.description: Earn 2 global Economy Plus seat upgrades after spending $40,000 each calendar year.

benefits.title: 1,000 Card Bonus PQP Each Year
benefits.description: Get a jump start on earning Premier status with 1,000 Card Bonus Premier qualifying points (PQP) each year. Awarded within 8 weeks of February 1.

benefits.title: PQP Earning on Purchases
benefits.description: Earn 1 Premier qualifying point (PQP) for every $20 spent on purchases with your Quest Card, up to 18,000 PQP per year.

benefits.title: Save 10%+ When Booking Flights with Miles
benefits.description: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles. Premier members save even more.

benefits.title: Up to $150 in Renowned Hotels Credits
benefits.description: Receive up to $150 back in statement credits each anniversary year on hotel accommodations when you prepay directly through Renowned Hotels and Resorts with your Quest Card.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in Rideshare Credits
benefits.description: Enroll to receive up to $100 back as statement credits each calendar year on rideshare purchases: up to $8 back each month from January through November and up to $12 back for December. Yearly opt-in required.

benefits.title: Up to $80 in Avis/Budget Credits
benefits.description: Receive $40 in United TravelBank cash, up to $80 each anniversary year, for 1st and 2nd Avis or Budget car rental booked directly through cars.united.com.

benefits.title: Up to $180 in Instacart Credits
benefits.description: Receive one $10 Instacart credit and one $5 Instacart credit monthly, up to $180 total each calendar year. Benefits end 12/31/27.

benefits.title: Up to $150 in JSX Credits
benefits.description: Get up to $150 back as a statement credit each anniversary year when you book flights directly with JSX using your Quest Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Purchases made with your Quest Card outside the U.S. will not be subject to foreign transaction fees.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: You can be reimbursed up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for your pre-paid, non-refundable passenger fares, if your trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather or other covered situations.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Get complimentary Visa Signature Concierge Service 24 hours a day. Find tickets to the top sports and entertainment events, make dinner reservations and even get help sending the perfect gift.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: If your common carrier travel is delayed more than 12 hours or requires an overnight stay, you are covered for unreimbursed expenses, such as meals and lodging, up to $500 per covered traveler.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental cost to your card. Coverage is primary and provides reimbursement up to $60,000 for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles with an MSRP of $125,000 or less.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.
